title: Base Read Input Registers variant 4
purpose: Vary unit identifier, starting address, and quantity across a request to exercise interactions among address selection and read span fields.

messages.label: Read Input Registers request, unit 14, address 0x01f0, quantity 8
Read Input Registers response (register data bytes)

expected_behavior: The server should parse both requests as Read Input Registers operations and return the corresponding input-register values when available, or normal Modbus exception responses for unsupported or out-of-range addresses.
constraints_preserved: Each frame has a 7-byte MBAP header.
Each length field 0006 accounts for the unit identifier and five-byte request PDU.
Function code 04 and its 16-bit address and quantity fields are structurally consistent.
The target address and quantity form a positive, moderate read span.
Unit identifier and transaction identifier values are valid-width and distinct from other seeds.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report is available. This is a conservative field-interaction seed based on model-prior protocol plausibility and is not externally verified.
